# Voting and P2P security matrix — implementation evidence, 2026-10-08

Avi's authorized plan is **not yet accepted or shipped**. This edition replaces the design baseline with an as-built matrix while preserving its complete 13-feature population. Authentication and reconstructed-tally plan items have committed completions. Remaining implementation acceptance, current-build runtime journeys, independent security review and exact deployed-artifact verification are open.

References below assign limitations to these existing items; they do not assert those items are complete.

## Threat model and vocabulary

An attacker can forge a claimed sender, key, signature or signed summary; replay, reorder or duplicate records; substitute an action after approval; present conflicting finalizations or escrow claims; attempt private reads/writes; or exploit a partition. A compromised delegated host can replace its verifier, database and logs, read keys/credentials resident on it, and lie about execution or metering.

An honest verifier independently anchors owner authority, signed policy, eligible public keys and current epochs. Ed25519 and SHA-256 security, key custody, correct device/GitHub binding and execution of the verifier are assumptions. A host holding all relevant signing keys can forge those signers. Same-host checks do not survive full host compromise. Independent signer thresholds or independently enforced chain contracts are needed for that stronger property, and actual deployment of them is not established here.

**Tested** means the named canonical executable cases passed at the recorded source. **Machine-checked abstract proof** means Z3 returned UNSAT for a stated negated abstract obligation under explicit preconditions. **Bounded conformance** means finite production transitions agreed with an independent oracle over the stated census. Neither is an unbounded proof of TypeScript, PostgreSQL, networking, cryptography, kernel isolation or external contracts. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN. Local dirty-source evidence is diagnostic and cannot establish exact committed or deployed acceptance.

Private revocation prevents new authorized access; it cannot erase previously downloaded bytes. Public logs, membership, content integrity, vote authority and spend authority are separate boundaries. No liveness during an unbounded partition, semantic truth, malicious-host remote attestation, provider honesty or funded/mainnet operation is proved.

## Receiver, finality and trust corrections — 2026-10-08 successor

The independent source review found F1 mutable receiver history and F2 authentic late-ballot poisoning. Both were canonically reproduced, then locally fixed under WI-10007532/33. GovernanceEvent.v1 receiver facts now use immutable inserts, refuse tombstones, validate content-addressed keys and independently owner-anchored Ed25519 envelopes, and require a receiver-resolved current member device for remote relay. A member may relay another authorized signer's authentic event; transport identity is distinct from vote signer authority. Generic mutable settings retain their prior semantics. The immutable full-fold path replays candidate puts rather than choosing a later malformed/deleted LWW winner. Pause and revoke history survive. Membership ordering reuses boot's bounded PendingMembershipContent buffer. Rows missing round dependencies remain provisional: the consumer must fully authenticate their dependencies and reconstruct before admission.

The helper governance-federation ingestion/PotBoundary unit surface is not the production privacy boundary. Production privacy uses generic source-log admission, receiver roster binding and encrypted scoped logs. This corrects the previous matrix's implicit production-path attribution.

The certificate commits exact voteEventIds, including selected replacement history. Duplicate IDs, missing listed ballots, bad signatures or mismatching reconstruction refuse. Unlisted late ballots cannot revise finality, including valid backdated sequence-1/sequence-2 ballots received before finalization on a different replica. The local append path refuses an unlisted vote after observing finalization. A listed ballot missing during a partition may later arrive and restore valid reconstruction.

These guards prove no exhaustive ballot-observation property: an authorized finalizer selects the committed snapshot. Completeness over every cast or withheld ballot assumes honest finalizer selection. A malicious finalizer still cannot fabricate selected signatures, bypass the exact electorate/weighted thresholds, or certify a false selected-set tally. D-007 explicitly names this limit.

OccurredAtMs, createdAtMs and finalizedAtMs are signer assertions, not timestamp attestations. Numeric chronology and future-time constraints are enforced. Expiry/ratification-window meaning assumes honest signer/verifier clocks. A valid round-open-role signer can supersede an admitted round by opening a newer one, suspending admission until the successor finalizes. That is an explicit governance capability, not an ordinary voter's authority.

F4 is fixed: finalizeGovernanceRound requires members at the TypeScript and runtime boundaries. No default unit-weight/unrevoked/no-epoch roster remains. Its only production caller supplies independently anchored authority members/delegations. The pure reducer does not verify signatures.

Current local evidence: /tmp/dao-security-persistence-recovery-merge-green-20261008.log = 14 real-PG plus 26 merge/projection cases PASS, zero skips. /tmp/dao-security-explicit-roster-20261008.log = 80 canonical cases PASS, zero skips. /tmp/dao-security-explicit-roster-types-20261008.log = zero type errors across the four named files and checked consumers. /tmp/dao-security-current22-roster-20261008.log = one parent driver PASS with 22 real-PG/DHT child assertions, IPC start/end, process disappearance and verified runtime/database directory removal. Source fingerprint 1f852232bfa5b2c1257d16c1549763de803a3ba921950c5590c9f54e11825928 stayed stable, but HEAD moved during that run. This is LOCAL evidence; exact committed replay and deployment are not established.

The proof scope remains abstract integer safety plus bounded production conformance. Receiver persistence, clocks, finalizer completeness, cryptography and network liveness are outside those formal claims. The new receiver/finality guards are tested, not model-checked. All earlier receipts below retain their historical source scope. This correction supersedes old pending runtime and implicit receiver/finality descriptions.

These measured assertions cover the files above, not the full baseline's unexecuted files.

E3: frozen 9ed83d94ec844a9824e4babb749d4154fd3d4a54 canonical 178-case security matrix, zero skipped; exact current bindings and committed completions WI-10007440/WI-10007441. Known exact rows: governance-voting 20928176, security-proofs 20928183, onchain-governance-bridge 20928184, plan-admission-certificate-source 20928185; clean authenticator mutation 20929081. Logs /tmp/dao-security-immutable-matrix-20261008.log and /tmp/dao-security-clean-auth-mutant-20261008.log. The subsequent auth test edit invalidates its old test fingerprint for final whole-plan acceptance. Unchanged proof/action/tally evidence is reused only after server measurement confirms currentness.

E4: pinned z3-solver 5.2.0 in package/lockfile, canonical packages/operator-core/lib/p2p/security-proofs.test.ts (Vitest and test:affected enrollment), clean row 20928183. The five solver cases establish abstract integer conservation (one arbitrary induction step from zero, exactly-one-bucket assumption), replacement conservation, admitted-threshold implication and escrow reserve/settle invariant preservation; known omitted-reservation SAT and UNKNOWN checks must throw. Initial preconditions are separately satisfiable. Four named property families are preserved; SAT, UNKNOWN, timeout/init failure are not proofs. This is abstract safety, with the model-to-implementation limit explicit.

The three finite conformance cases enumerate 27 three-member delegation graphs and 64 terminal ballot combinations with weights 2/3/5 and replacement; weight buckets 0..3 with thresholds [0,3333,5000,6667,10000], distinguishing abstention from uncast weight; reachable signed reserve/settle/replay traces to depth 4, escrow 3, reservation deltas 1/2 and actual settlement 0..reserved. Authenticated admission and trusted seller receipts are preconditions. No unbounded partition, crypto/network/DB, malicious-host or external-contract theorem follows.

## Remaining acceptance and shipment

The exact 13-feature population is retained. Current receiver/finality/roster changes have local canonical verification. Clean committed replay, fresh R-5/proof/census adequacy and independent completion audit remain open. The prior reviewer ended and its consult cascade exhausted; the successor review must include the omitted full boot/join owner-key trust anchor and this complete matrix. Earlier integrity-card states are historical snapshots, not current completion assertions.

Current-build routes remain staging operator API and the isolated background runtime. Actual background22-case evidence is described above; actual HTTP/API ratification and bounded execution remain open. P-008 still requires containing shipped source, migrations, runtime/rollback and accepted clauses. No shipped status is claimed. WI-10007442..46 and WI-10007531 remain accountable. This session implements directly under AUTO without native subagents/manual git commits and preserves financial/mainnet gates.
